params.body:
## Why

Since PR 487 merged (c346de3), main's CI is red: `FrenchLeftoversTest::the settings and the menu speak french` finds "Handleiding" on the website settings tab rendered for a French user. PRs 484 and 487 added the embed block (title, embed code label and help, the legacy note, the preview / guide / mail links, the mailto subject and body, the "Geavanceerd" fold) as hard-coded Dutch.

## What changed

- Every user-visible string of the embed block comes from `resources/lang/*/website.php` (`embed_*` keys) in nl, fr, en and de; French and German are real translations. Dutch text is byte-identical to what was there, so `WebsiteEmbedScriptTest`, `SettingsWebsiteIframeLanguageTest` and the other pins keep passing.
- The mailto subject and body travel as `data-mail-subject` / `data-mail-body` in the user's language; Alpine fills `:dealer`, `:line`, `:preview`, `:guide` and turns line breaks into CRLF. A French dealer mails a French web builder in French.
- The embed copy button reuses `showroom.copy` / `showroom.copied` instead of a second hard-coded Gekopieerd/Kopieer.
- `WebsiteEmbedSettingsTest`: the mailto assertion follows the new shape, and a new test renders the tab for a French user and checks every key is shown in French and differs from Dutch, with no Dutch left.

No hot shared files touched (`ui.php`, `refresh.css`, `app.blade.php`, `SmokeTest` untouched).

## Tests

`vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'FrenchLeftoversTest|LanguageParityTest|FrenchTranslationsTest|WebsiteEmbedSettingsTest|WebsiteEmbedScriptTest|SettingsWebsiteIframeLanguageTest|AlpineExpressionTest|CompiledViewsTest'`: OK, 29 tests, 305 assertions (1 pre-existing incomplete). `SmokeTest` filtered on settings: OK, 17 tests.
params.title: Website settings: the embed block speaks the user's language (fixes main's FrenchLeftoversTest)
